source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units with this ability, other than **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units, gain three abilities. **Encircling Jaws**: under the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, the unit adds 1 to its Charge rolls and Advance rolls. **Hunter's Eye**: under the **[devastator doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its ranged attacks may re-roll a [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1. **Ferocious Strike**: under the **[tactical doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its attacks gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** against an enemy unit that the card describes as "with" 9 inches. Your **LOGAN GRIMNAR** units have **Howling Onslaught**, which your army can use once per battle during your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase); when used, your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units also benefit from **Master of Wolves** until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) starts. **Restrictions**: **SPACE WOLVES** units are allowed in your army, but **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units from any other Chapter are not. The card reads "with" rather than "within" before the 9-inch distance, so it does not settle which enemy units **Ferocious Strike** covers.

armyRestriction.forbids: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter

openPoints: Ferocious Strike's range condition is printed as 'with 9 inches', not 'within 9 inches'
